findings.title: earnings_predictions: beat_rate None for all 41 tickers
findings.description: yfinance is not returning historical EPS beat rate data. beat_rate is used to adjust BEAT/MISS conviction — None means it falls back to base reasoning only.
findings.proposed_fix: Check yfinance earningsHistory availability; fall back to SEC EDGAR or a fixed historical beat-rate average per sector.

findings.title: None score in sector_assignments.json (8 sector(s))
findings.description: Sectors assigned with None scores: ['Regional Banks', 'Technology', 'Cybersecurity', 'Semiconductors', 'Defense & Aerospace', 'Real Estate', 'Cloud & SaaS', 'Healthcare']. Agent assignment decisions based on null scores may produce arbitrary sector priority ordering.
findings.proposed_fix: In rd_team_leader.py: filter out sectors with None scores before ranking. Treat None as score=0 or skip entirely.

findings.title: yfinance beat_rate coverage restored: 100% of sample tickers
findings.description: yfinance earnings history now available for 5/5 sample tickers. Earnings predictor beat_rate can now be re-enabled. Gap lasted 33 day(s).
findings.proposed_fix: Re-enable beat_rate in earnings_predictor.py and remove the MEDIUM known-gap finding.
